Voting application allows users to register, login and vote for candidates. Users can enter their name, age, address, mobile number, Aadhaar card number, email and password and login with their Aadhaar card number and password. Admin users can add, update, and delete candidates. And don't vote for Admin candidates. The app uses JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for authentication and authorization. The app uses MongoDB as a database, which contains two collections: users and preferences. The user collection stores user data, while the candidate collection stores candidate data.
